newsitem.title: USA: ProCyte gets FDA clearance for dressing.
newsitem.headline: ProCyte gets FDA clearance for dressing.

text.p: ProCyte Corp said it received 510(k) device clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to market a gauze wound dressing that contains the company's patented copper peptide technology.

The new product, called GraftCyte Moist Dressings, is scheduled for market release in April 1997 and helps reduce shedding of transplanted hair follicles, which commonly occurs after hair transplant surgery.

The GraftCyte Moist Dressings incorporate ProCyte's patented copper peptide technology in a gel impregnated gauze that has been shown to help maintain the optimal environment for healing and revascularization of the graft site.
